title: Scalar actions for exceptional pro-etale operations
statement: For the fixed strict etale exceptional adjunction, site comparisons and pro-etale compact-support package, there are canonical coefficient scalar-action packages on the source and target pro-etale systems, and both exceptional composites carry derived scalar multiplication to the corresponding scalar component.

proof.text: Define multiplication by the scalar image on each quotient coefficient sheaf, form the compatible ordinary system endomorphisms, and descend them through derived localization. The comparison equations for inverse image, open extension, proper direct image and the etale right adjoint transport these maps through both composites. The localization universal property gives the two displayed derived linearity equations.

proof_origin.place: Separated scalar-localization portion of system-transport step 8

lean.statement: theorem exceptionalProScalarActions : ∃ (scalarX : ExceptionalProScalarAction X O ell) (scalarY : ExceptionalProScalarAction Y O ell), (∀ r M, (exceptionalProSupport P).map ((scalarX.derived r).app M) = (scalarY.derived r).app ((exceptionalProSupport P).obj M)) ∧ (∀ r N, (exceptionalSystemRight G CX CY).map ((scalarY.derived r).app N) = (scalarX.derived r).app ((exceptionalSystemRight G CX CY).obj N))
